Title: Unmapped Module: 'app'
Explanation: The module 'app' cannot be assigned to any defined architecture component.
Remediation: Add a mapping pattern for this module in architecture definition or relocate file to the appropriate component directory.

Title: Forbidden Dependency: 'domain' -> 'presentation'
Explanation: Module 'app.domain.order' in 'domain' imports 'app.presentation.routes' in 'presentation'. Domain core must never depend directly on the presentation layer.
Remediation: Remove the import of 'app.presentation.routes' from 'app.domain.order'. Use dependency injection or an intermediary abstraction.

Title: Layer Violation: 'domain' (L3) -> 'presentation' (L1)
Explanation: Lower layer 'domain' (Layer 3) depends upward on higher layer 'presentation' (Layer 1). Rule: Dependencies must only flow downward through layers. Lower layers cannot depend on upper layers.
Remediation: Refactor 'app.domain.order' to invert the dependency using an interface/protocol defined in 'domain' and implemented in 'presentation'.

Title: Layer Violation: 'infrastructure' (L4) -> 'domain' (L3)
Explanation: Lower layer 'infrastructure' (Layer 4) depends upward on higher layer 'domain' (Layer 3). Rule: Dependencies must only flow downward through layers. Lower layers cannot depend on upper layers.
Remediation: Refactor 'app.infrastructure.database' to invert the dependency using an interface/protocol defined in 'infrastructure' and implemented in 'domain'.

Title: Circular Component Dependency: presentation -> application -> domain -> presentation
Explanation: A circular dependency cycle was detected between components: presentation -> application -> domain -> presentation. Cycles create tight coupling and prevent clean modular testing and deployment.
Evidence: Cycle path: presentation -> application -> domain -> presentation
Remediation: Break the cycle along presentation -> application -> domain -> presentation using the Dependency Inversion Principle, events, or splitting shared logic into a common domain/utility module.

Title: Circular Module Dependency: app.presentation.routes -> app.application.order_service -> app.domain.order -> app.presentation.routes
Explanation: A circular dependency cycle was detected between modules: app.presentation.routes -> app.application.order_service -> app.domain.order -> app.presentation.routes.
Remediation: Extract shared types or functions from app.presentation.routes and app.domain.order into a separate module.
